title: Meeting With The Guru, Nanak Has Recognized
summary: The shabad does not leave hukam at diagnosis. It turns toward return.
takeaway: Meeting with the Guru, Nanak has recognized the Supreme Lord God
lifeApplication: Name one thing already here that you need to stop negotiating with. After the reaction, make the next return smaller and truer.

source.shortMeaning: Like a foolish child, I have made mistakes. O Lord, You are; meeting with the Guru, Nanak has recognized the Supreme Lord God
source.lifeApplication: Return begins when the later line is allowed to outlast the first rush of feeling.

evidence.coreClaim: Like a foolish child, I have made mistakes. O Lord, You are; meeting with the Guru, Nanak has recognized the Supreme Lord God
evidence.turn: Hukam steadies when meeting with the Guru, Nanak has recognized the Supreme Lord God.
evidence.practicalImplication: Name one thing already here that you need to stop negotiating with. After the reaction, make the next return smaller and truer.
